subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled Claude/GLM app-server runtime backed by a maintainer-owned package, or require this optional capability to ship as an external plugin/ClawHub package?
rationale: The unresolved choice determines package custody, security-response ownership, persistent-state design, auth contract placement, and whether the current core changes should exist at all; these are product and security boundary decisions rather than mechanical fixes.

options.title: Require an external plugin
options.body: Keep the Claude/GLM bridge outside core using current plugin seams, and only propose narrowly justified generic SDK additions if an actual extension API gap remains.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled runtime
options.body: Adopt a maintainer-owned bridge package and approve the long-term auth, SQLite migration, release, and security ownership model before a narrower implementation is reviewed.

recommendation.title: Require an external plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the Claude/GLM bridge outside core using current plugin seams, and only propose narrowly justified generic SDK additions if an actual extension API gap remains.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history records product-direction input from Eddie on the central Claude session and workflow design, while the decision requires repository-level sponsorship.
